messages:
morgan: STANDUP (async) — SLOs / alerting / oncall updates
What I did: rolled kv-cache eviction patch to canary, ran 2h loadbench against canary, tightened 5xx alert thresholds.
Blockers: seeing sporadic 99.9 tail latency regressions (~1-2%) on p99 buckets; correlates with GC spikes on hosts older-gpu-*.
Today: promote canary if no regressions, open ticket for GC mitigation, coordinate host drain with infra.
Command I ran: ```kubectl -n infra rollout status deploy/kv-evict-canary```

tara: Thanks — which grafana panels should I watch if the canary goes noisy?

morgan: panel: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/ABCD/slo-latency?orgId=1&view=canary :eyes: I'll add alert thresholds & the query I used to the ticket.

devon: Oncall notes: saw two alerts overnight, both auto-resolved. Both were kv-evict-related but short-lived. Also noticed a lot of noise from the prometheus rule `kv_cache_evictions` — might need debounce.

alex: Quick CR ping @morgan on PR #4123 — left a note about retry backoff and an extra log line that should be removed before merge. Small change, can approve after that.

morgan: ack — will update today. Adding a canary rollback policy: if host errors >= 4% for 5min -> rollback.

lee: Scheduling note — draining old-gpu-3 at 15:30 UTC to repro the GC behavior. Will cordon + drain and coordinate with infra. Tagging @devon for handoff overlap.

devon: ACK — I can take handoff at 15:20 UTC. Proposal: increase alert debounce from 10s -> 30s for the kv_eviction rule to cut alert spam while we validate.

sre-bot: [automated] Alert fired: `kv-eviction-error-rate` at 2234568000 (3 instances). Auto-action: paused canary traffic and started rollback window.

morgan: That was the canary — noisy start, initiating manual rollback now. I'll open a short incident thread if it persists.

alex: FYI I'll run a quick regression eval against the small prompt set after rollback/rollforward. ETA ~2h. Will post results here.

morgan: Blocker update: created ticket #714 (GC mitigation + reproducer steps) and assigned to @tara. Reproducer: run `loadbench --profile=p99-heavy --hosts=old-gpu-*` for 15m, watch `jvm.gc.pause` and `process_cpu_seconds_total`.

tara: Taking #714 — will triage and propose JVM flags or new base image. If we need infra help for image bake, looping them in.

devon: No other open alerts from my side. If rollback completes cleanly, I'll continue monitoring for 30m then clear the handoff.

morgan: Thanks all — will post follow-ups (metrics, logs) into the ticket. :thumbsup:
